mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.enabled=TRUE JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id=rm.menu_id AND m.enabled=TRUE WHERE u.enabled=TRUE AND r.data_scope=1 AND m.permission_code='system:security:administer'

SELECT CAST(m.id AS CHAR) AS id, m.menu_name AS name, m.route_path AS path, m.component_key AS component, m.permission_code AS permission FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.enabled=TRUE JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id=rm.menu_id AND m.enabled=TRUE WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND m.menu_type='C' GROUP BY m.id, m.menu_name, m.route_path, m.component_key, m.permission_code, m.sort_order ORDER BY m.sort_order, id
